skills.name: Stampede
skills.description:
Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff5107|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

After reaching your target, you sunder the ground beneath you, dealing |cffffff1212|r Physical Damage to all enemies in the area every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff15|r seconds.

skills.name: Recuperative Treatise
skills.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff4028|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

skills.name: Relentless Focus
skills.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff14503|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

skills.name: Concealed Weapon
skills.description:
Slash an enemy, dealing |cffffff8863|r Magic Damage. 

If you strike an enemy from their flank you set them Off Balance.

When you leave Sneak or invisibility while in combat, increase your damage done with this ability by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff15|r seconds.

While slotted on either bar, you gain Minor Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

skills.name: Soul Harvest
skills.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff12891|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
